run_offline_eval: run offline evaluation of a robotics model checkpoint against MCAP demonstration episodes
build_timestep_spec: build a TimeStepSpec from an MCAP episode's first observation for policy inference
compute_episode_metrics: compute chunk MSE, step MSE, and per-joint MSE metrics for predicted vs ground-truth actions
aggregate_metrics: aggregate per-episode metrics into mean and standard deviation across all episodes
plot_joint_grid: plot predicted vs ground-truth per-joint actions in a grid layout with chunk-boundary markers
